configuration.title: BeCoder IDE Features
configuration.welcome.onlineJudgeSites.d: Website names and URLs for Welcome page shortcuts. Add an HTTP or HTTPS website here, then add its name to `#becoder.welcome.onlineJudges#` to display it. Custom links do not automatically support problem or test case import.
configuration.welcome.onlineJudges.title: Welcome Page: Visible Websites
configuration.welcome.onlineJudges.descr: Website names to display under Online Judges on the Welcome page, in display order. First add the name and URL to `#becoder.welcome.onlineJudgeSites#`, then add the same name here. An empty list hides the section. Changes take effect immediately; links open in the built-in browser.
configuration.displayLanguage.title: Display Language
configuration.displayLanguage.descriptio: Select the display language for BeCoder. The change takes effect after restart.
configuration.newFileDefaultLanguage: Default language for files created from the New Tab page.
configuration.inlayHints.title: C/C++ Inlay Hints
configuration.inlayHints.description: Shows inferred types, parameter names, and other inlay hints provided by clangd.
